config.title: Write a function to group items by key

intro.title: Write a function to group items by key
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a function that organizes a list of objects into groups based on a shared property, like grouping people by their city. You'll learn how to use JavaScript objects to create these groups by iterating through an array with a loop. The main constructs involved are arrays, objects, and functions. By the end, you'll have a practical tool for data organization that's useful in many real-world applications.
intro.usecase: Grouping data by key is essential for organizing information in user interfaces. In e-commerce dashboards, products are grouped by category to help users browse efficiently. Analytics platforms use this pattern to aggregate user data by region or time period for visualizations. Content management systems group articles by tags or authors to create organized listings. This function provides the foundation for creating structured, filterable displays that users interact with daily.

objectives: Construct a function that accepts an array of objects and a grouping key as parameters
Initialize an empty object to store the grouped results
Implement iteration logic to process each item in the input array
Apply conditional logic to check for existing groups and create new ones as needed
Manipulate the grouping object to add items to their respective key-based categories
Configure the function to return the final grouped object
Integrate the grouping function into a complete JavaScript program
